literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Seasonal vaccination elicited antibodies that recognized several HA and NA antigens, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. [10.1128/jvi.01310-26]

Phylogenetic analyses identified nine distinct genotypes, designated Kor24–25A to Kor24–25I. The most commonly detected genotype, Kor24–25A (n = 24), was frequently found in Pelecaniformes and was most prevalent between December 2024 and January 2025. [10.1186/s13567-026-01847-2]
The results confirmed host-specific fitness characteristics of the viruses that align with in vivo observations. [10.1128/spectrum.00843-26]

Here, we investigated the impact of PB2-627K on viral fitness in avian hosts to assess the potential for mammalian-adapted viruses to re-establish in birds, mimicking infection of avian species following scavenging on mammalian species where PB2-627K has already emerged. [10.64898/2026.10.06.757006]

动物福利组织批评犹他州水貂养殖场对禽流感暴发的反应。

news.headline_en: Avian Flu Spreads to More Farms, Raising Public Health Concerns.
news.lead_en: The U.S. and Canada have reported more avian flu cases, including the first detection of avian flu in dairy cattle, highlighting the risk of zoonotic transmission.
key_findings_en: The U.S. Department of Agriculture confirmed the first detection of avian flu in dairy cattle.
Canada's Manitoba has reported another case of highly pathogenic avian influenza.
The H5N1 avian influenza virus is spreading in farms and wild animals, raising public health concerns.
Animal welfare groups criticized the response to a bird flu outbreak at a Utah mink farm.

papers.title: H3 Subtype Avian Influenza Virus: Ecology, Cross-Species Evolution, and Public Health Threats
papers.abstract: H3 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) is one of the most widely distributed and frequently detected low-pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) in wild birds and poultry worldwide. Wild waterfowl are the natural reservoir of this virus. In recent years, driven by frequent genetic reassortment and continuous evolution, H3 subtype AIV has expanded its host range to include various mammalian species—dogs, cats, horses, seals, pigs (experimental infection), and humans. Among these, the H3N8 subtype shows the broadest cross-species transmissibility, having established sustained transmission lineages in horses and dogs, while also causing sporadic infections in seals and humans. Avian-origin H3N2 canine influenza virus has circulated stably in dog populations across Asia and North America for nearly two decades. Between 2022 and 2023, China reported three human cases of H3N8 subtype AIV infection, one of which was fatal (Guangdong, March 2023), indicating that this virus poses a potential zoonotic transmission risk. Novel triple-reassortant strains, including genotype G25 of H3N8 and H3N3, first detected in chicken flocks in late 2022, have continued to emerge. Their HA genes originate from H3 subtype viruses of wild bird or chicken origin, whereas their internal gene segments are predominantly acquired from H9N2 subtype AIV, resulting in enhanced mammalian adaptability. This review summarizes the global epidemiology of H3 subtype AIV (covering wild birds, poultry, and live poultry markets), its genetic evolution and reassortment patterns, and the molecular mechanisms underlying cross-species transmission. This review particularly highlights the regulatory roles of key amino acid mutations—such as PB2-D701N, M1-M192V, and HA-Q226L/G228S—in receptor binding preference, polymerase activity, and pathogenicity. This review also summarizes recent advances in detection techniques (multiplex RT-PCR, quantum dot-based immunochromatographic strips, RT-RAA, and CRISPR-Cas13a) and vaccine development (inactivated, adenovirus-vectored, and mRNA vaccines). Key prevention and control challenges—including covert circulation, surveillance gaps, and limited subtyping diagnostic capacity at primary laboratories—are also discussed. This review proposes that H3 subtype AIV should be recognized as a potential zoonotic threat warranting continued surveillance, although no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission has been documented to date. Better understanding of cross-species mechanisms, stronger surveillance and early warning, and evidence-based control strategies are needed to inform future risk assessment.

papers.title: Pre-existing cross-subtype serological responses against H5Nx in health care workers
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: A rise in cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b in humans has been reported since 2023. Although influenza seasonal vaccination (H1N1/H3N2) was shown to be effective against cases of reinfection with endemic influenza A viruses (IAVs), its capacity to elicit cross-reactive antibodies against (H5N1) remains unclear. Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

Here, we measured vaccine-elicited antibody responses against seasonal (H1N1/H3N2) and various avian subtypes A (H5Nx) using plasma samples from the CRCHUM Health Care Workers cohort in Montreal, Canada, during the 2024 influenza seasonal vaccination. The capacity of their plasma to recognize hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA) antigens from ten influenza strains was measured. Their neutralizing activity, as well as their capacity to mediate antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) against cells stably expressing HA and NA, was measured. Overall, seasonal vaccination against H1N1/H3N2 elicited antibodies able to recognize several HA and NA, and in some individuals, this translated to increased neutralization and ADCC activity, including against H5Nx. This study provides insightful information on how vaccination shapes cross-reactive antibody responses against avian H5Nx. IMPORTANCE: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) are endemic in the human population and responsible for hundreds of thousands of deaths every year, occasionally leading to influenza pandemics. Since 2023, there has been a rise in avian IAV infections in humans, with some deaths reported, mostly related to the H5N1 subtype clade 2.3.4.4b. Seasonal vaccines against IAVs are effective, but their efficacy against avian IAVs is not well known. Here, following influenza seasonal vaccination in a cohort of adults, we report highly heterogeneous serological responses, possibly due to pre-existing immunity and HA sequence similarity. These findings provide insight into the breadth of pre-existing and vaccine-induced immunity against H5 influenza viruses and may inform the development of vaccination strategies aimed at providing broader protection against emerging influenza viruses.

papers.abstract_zh: 未标记:自 2023 年以来,据报道人类 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 分支 2.3.4.4b 病例有所增加。尽管季节性流感 疫苗接种 (H1N1/H3N2) 被证明可有效对抗地方性甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 的再感染病例,但其引发针对 (H5N1) 交叉反应抗体的能力仍不清楚。在这里,我们使用 2024 年流感季节性 疫苗接种 期间加拿大蒙特利尔 CRCHUM 卫生保健工作者 队列研究 的血浆样本测量了 疫苗 引发的针对季节性 (H1N1/H3N2) 和各种禽类 A 亚型 (H5Nx) 的抗体反应。测量了它们的血浆识别十种流感病毒株的血凝素(HA)和神经氨酸酶(NA)抗原的能力。测量了它们的中和活性,以及​​它们介导针对稳定表达 HA 和 NA 的细胞的抗体依赖性细胞毒性 (ADCC) 的能力。总体而言,针对 H1N1/H3N2 的季节性 疫苗接种 引发了能够识别多种 HA 和 NA 的抗体,并且在某些个体中,这转化为中和和 ADCC 活性的增加,包括针对 H5Nx 的抗体。这项研究提供了有关 疫苗接种 如何形成针对禽类 H5Nx 的交叉反应抗体反应的深刻信息。重要性:甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 在人群中流行,每年导致数十万人死亡,有时还会导致流感大流行。自 2023 年以来,人类感染禽类 IAV 的数量有所增加,并报告了一些死亡病例,其中大部分与 H5N1 亚型分支 2.3.4.4b 有关。季节性 疫苗 对 IAV 有效,但其对禽 IAV 的功效尚不清楚。在这里,在成人 队列研究 中出现季节性流感 队列研究 后,我们报告了高度异质性的血清学反应,可能是由于预先存在的免疫力和 HA 序列相似性。这些发现提供了对预先存在的和 疫苗 诱导的针对 H5 流感病毒的免疫力的广度的深入了解,并可能为 疫苗接种 策略的开发提供信息,该策略旨在针对新出现的流感病毒提供更广泛的保护。

papers.title: Multiple introductions and spread of novel reassortant highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b viruses via wild birds, South Korea, 2024–2025
papers.abstract: Abstract Between 14 October 2024 and 24 March 2025, 43 cases of clade 2.3.4.4b highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) type A (H5N1) infections in wild birds and 1 case in a leopard cat were detected through the national HPAI surveillance program. We performed whole-genome sequencing of 51 isolates and investigated their phylogenetic relationships. Phylogenetic analyses identified nine distinct genotypes, designated Kor24–25A to Kor24–25I. The most commonly detected genotype, Kor24–25A ( n = 24), was frequently detected in Pelecaniformes and was most prevalent between December 2024 and January 2025. Bayesian continuous and discrete trait phylodynamic analyses using HA gene sequences identified the three most probable routes of viral introduction via Gyeonggi, Jeju, and the southern coastal areas of the Korean Peninsula and suggested that wild ducks served as the primary reservoirs facilitating viral transmission in the wild bird population. During the 2024–2025 season, great egrets ( Ardea alba ) appeared to be more frequently affected than other wild bird species, suggesting possible seasonal differences in species-specific disease outcomes among wild birds. This study provides valuable insights into the phylodynamics, host associations, and transmission patterns of HPAI H5N1 viruses. It emphasizes the importance of enhanced surveillance programs targeting key avian hosts and high-risk geographic areas.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 2024 年至 2025 年期间新型重配 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒在韩国的多次引入和传播,满足了解 野生鸟类 人群中这些新兴病毒株的 流行病学 和 传播 动态的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2024 年 10 月 14 日至 2025 年 3 月 24 日在韩国各地进行,重点关注 野生鸟类 和一只豹猫,作为国家 HPAI 监测 计划的一部分。野生鸟类共检测出43例,豹猫1例。
elements_zh.methods: 对 51 个分离株进行全 基因组 测序以研究它们的系统发育关系,并使用 HA 基因序列进行贝叶斯连续和离散性状系统动力学分析,以确定病毒引入途径和 宿主 关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析确定了九种不同的基因型,命名为 Kor24-25A 至 Kor24-25I。最常检测到的基因型 Kor24–25A (n = 24) 常见于鹈鹕目,并且在 2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 1 月期间最为流行。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,野鸭是 野生鸟类 群体中病毒 传播 的主要 储存宿主,而大白鹭 (Ardea alba) 似乎比其他物种更频繁地受到影响,这表明疾病结果可能存在季节性差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了对 HPAI H5N1 病毒的系统动力学和 宿主 关联的见解,强调了在关键禽类 宿主 和高风险地理区域中靶向 宿主 对防止潜在人畜共患传播的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于监测数据和系统发育分析,可能会受到抽样偏差和限制的影响。证据是温和的,因为它依赖于观察数据而不是实验方法。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查 2024 年至 2025 年期间新型重配 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒在韩国的多次引入和传播,满足了解 野生鸟类 人群中这些新兴病毒株的 流行病学 和 传播 动态的需要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2024 年 10 月 14 日至 2025 年 3 月 24 日在韩国各地进行,重点关注 野生鸟类 和一只豹猫,作为国家 HPAI 监测 计划的一部分。野生鸟类共检测出43例,豹猫1例。
analysis_zh.methods: 对 51 个分离株进行全 基因组 测序以研究它们的系统发育关系,并使用 HA 基因序列进行贝叶斯连续和离散性状系统动力学分析,以确定病毒引入途径和 宿主 关联。
analysis_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析确定了九种不同的基因型,命名为 Kor24-25A 至 Kor24-25I。最常检测到的基因型 Kor24–25A (n = 24) 常见于鹈鹕目,并且在 2024 年 12 月至 2025 年 1 月期间最为流行。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,野鸭是 野生鸟类 群体中病毒 传播 的主要 储存宿主,而大白鹭 (Ardea alba) 似乎比其他物种更频繁地受到影响,这表明疾病结果可能存在季节性差异。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供了对 HPAI H5N1 病毒的系统动力学和 宿主 关联的见解,强调了在关键禽类 宿主 和高风险地理区域中靶向 宿主 对防止潜在人畜共患传播的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于监测数据和系统发育分析,可能会受到抽样偏差和限制的影响。证据是温和的,因为它依赖于观察数据而不是实验方法。

papers.title: A Phase 1/2 Dose-Ranging Safety and Immunogenicity Study of mRNA-Based Candidate Pandemic Influenza Vaccines in Healthy Adults.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza A viruses pose a persistent pandemic threat. We report safety, reactogenicity, and immunogenicity findings for mRNA-1018 pandemic influenza vaccine candidates from a phase 1/2 study in healthy adults. METHODS: In part A, participants were randomized to receive 1 of 4 mRNA-1018 candidates at 1 of 3 dose levels across 2 influenza A groups: (1) H5N8/H5-only or (2) H7N9/H7-only. Part B participants were randomized to receive H5-only-CG. The primary objectives were to evaluate the safety and reactogenicity. The secondary objectives included evaluation of humoral immunogenicity through day 205 by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI), neuraminidase inhibition, and microneutralization assays. RESULTS: Parts A and B comprised 1195 and 304 dosed participants, respectively. Overall, solicited local adverse reactions (ARs) within 7 days of vaccination occurred in 76.8% of participants across vaccine candidates and dose levels, most commonly injection-site pain. Solicited systemic ARs were reported in 62.8% of participants, most frequently fatigue and headache. Postvaccination immune responses, assessed absolutely, by HAI titers and dynamically, by seroconversion rates, tended to increase with vaccine dose. H5-based candidates induced stronger strain-specific HAI. CONCLUSIONS: Vaccine candidates were sufficiently well tolerated and immunogenic. Further development of mRNA pandemic influenza vaccines is warranted.Clinical Trials Registration.
papers.journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America

analysis.methods: In part A, participants were randomized to receive 1 of 4 mRNA-1018 candidates at 1 of 3 dose levels across 2 influenza A groups: (1) H5N8/H5-only or (2) H7N9/H7-only. The primary objectives were to evaluate the safety and reactogenicity.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of mRNA-based pandemic influenza vaccines and suggest that higher doses may enhance immunogenicity. They also highlight the need for further research on vaccine safety and efficacy in different populations.

analysis.summary_en: This phase 1/2 study evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of mRNA-based pandemic influenza vaccine candidates in healthy adults. The research aimed to address the persistent pandemic threat posed by influenza A viruses. Participants were randomized to receive different mRNA-1018 candidates at varying dose levels, with some groups receiving H5N8 or H7N9-specific vaccines. The study found that solicited local and systemic adverse reactions were common, with injection-site pain and fatigue being the most frequently reported. Immune responses, measured by hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) titers and seroconversion rates, increased with higher vaccine doses. H5-based vaccines showed stronger strain-specific immune responses. The results suggest that these vaccine candidates are well-tolerated and immunogenic, supporting further development. However, the study's focus on healthy adults limits its applicability to broader populations, and the moderate evidence level reflects the need for additional research.

papers.title: Mathematical modeling of in vitro replication dynamics for multiple highly pathogenic avian influenza clade 2.3.4.4 viruses in chicken and duck cells
papers.abstract: The introduction, spread, and subsequent detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) in poultry are influenced by the virus replication fitness, transmission fitness, and virulence. Quantifying these fitness parameters is important for implementing surveillance and control measures for poultry. This study employs an avian in vitro model using primary chicken embryo fibroblast and duck embryo fibroblast to identify cellular correlates of fitness for a reference panel of eight dominant, highly pathogenic avian influenza clade 2.3.4.4 virus genotypes (H5N1, H5N8, and H5N6) isolated between 2014 and 2024. Because HPAIVs are pantropic in poultry, the use of primary fibroblasts could provide a robust systemic model to assess virus fitness in different poultry species. By integrating longitudinal infectious virus titers and cytopathogenicity data with a mathematical model, which delineates cell populations into susceptible, latent, infectious, and dead compartments, we disentangled "traditional" virological parameters such as peak virus titer and time to 50% cell death from mechanistic parameters, including the infecting time ([Formula: see text]), generation time ([Formula: see text]), and basic reproduction number (R0). Our results confirm host-specific fitness characteristics consistent with in vivo observations. This study underscores the potential of integrating avian in vitro models with mathematical modeling to provide high-resolution characterization of genetically similar viruses, building toward rapid risk assessments of novel HPAIVs.IMPORTANCEHighly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks in poultry have resulted in the culling of millions of animals over the past decade. The introduction and spread of HPAI in poultry are driven by the ability of the virus to replicate, transmit, and cause disease, which varies among different poultry species. These viral fitness traits can change quickly through mutations or reassortment, leading to new variants with an altered risk of introduction and transmission. In this study, we integrated an in vitro and mathematical model to assess the viral fitness of genetically similar viruses and the risk they represent for two important poultry species. This approach offers a rapid and scalable alternative to traditional animal models, aligning with the 3R's principle and supporting rapid assessment of the viral fitness of emerging virus variants for poultry. This approach can be easily expanded to other species, including humans, and is suitable to assess the viral fitness of all viral pathogens.
authors: Wim H. M. van der Poel

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how the replication fitness, transmission fitness, and virulence of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) influence their introduction, spread, and detection in poultry.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used an in vitro model with primary chicken embryo fibroblast and duck embryo fibroblast cells to assess the fitness of eight dominant HPAIV clade 2.3.4.4 genotypes (H5N1, H5N8, and H5N6) isolated between 2014 and 2024.
analysis.methods: The researchers integrated longitudinal infectious virus titers and cytopathogenicity data with a mathematical model that categorized cell populations into susceptible, latent, infectious, and dead compartments to differentiate traditional virological parameters from mechanistic ones.
analysis.main_results: The results confirmed host-specific fitness characteristics of the viruses that align with in vivo observations.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the potential of combining avian in vitro models with mathematical modeling to provide high-resolution insights into the fitness of genetically similar viruses, aiding in the rapid risk assessment of novel HPAIVs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a scalable and rapid method for assessing viral fitness of emerging variants in poultry, supporting surveillance and control strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro models and does not account for in vivo complexities, but the evidence is robust due to the integration of multiple data sources and mathematical modeling.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the replication dynamics of highly pathogenic avian influenza clade 2.3.4.4 viruses in chicken and duck cells to understand their fitness characteristics. By employing an in vitro model and mathematical analysis, the researchers disentangled traditional virological parameters from mechanistic ones, confirming host-specific traits consistent with in vivo observations. The approach provides a rapid and scalable method for assessing viral fitness, which can support surveillance and control measures in poultry. However, the study is limited to in vitro conditions and does not account for in vivo complexities, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. The integration of longitudinal data with modeling offers high-resolution insights into viral behavior, enhancing the ability to predict and manage outbreaks of novel HPAIVs.

papers.title_zh: 鸡鸭细胞中多种 高致病性禽流感 进化枝 2.3.4.4 病毒体外复制动力学的数学模型
papers.source_body_en: The introduction, spread, and subsequent detection of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (HPAIVs) in poultry are influenced by the virus replication fitness, transmission fitness, and virulence. Quantifying these fitness parameters is important for implementing surveillance and control measures for poultry. This study employs an avian in vitro model using primary chicken embryo fibroblast and duck embryo fibroblast to identify cellular correlates of fitness for a reference panel of eight dominant, highly pathogenic avian influenza clade 2.3.4.4 virus genotypes (H5N1, H5N8, and H5N6) isolated between 2014 and 2024. Because HPAIVs are pantropic in poultry, the use of primary fibroblasts could provide a robust systemic model to assess virus fitness in different poultry species. By integrating longitudinal infectious virus titers and cytopathogenicity data with a mathematical model, which delineates cell populations into susceptible, latent, infectious, and dead compartments, we disentangled "traditional" virological parameters such as peak virus titer and time to 50% cell death from mechanistic parameters, including the infecting time ([Formula: see text]), generation time ([Formula: see text]), and basic reproduction number (R0). Our results confirm host-specific fitness characteristics consistent with in vivo observations. This study underscores the potential of integrating avian in vitro models with mathematical modeling to provide high-resolution characterization of genetically similar viruses, building toward rapid risk assessments of novel HPAIVs.IMPORTANCEHighly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks in poultry have resulted in the culling of millions of animals over the past decade. The introduction and spread of HPAI in poultry are driven by the ability of the virus to replicate, transmit, and cause disease, which varies among different poultry species. These viral fitness traits can change quickly through mutations or reassortment, leading to new variants with an altered risk of introduction and transmission. In this study, we integrated an in vitro and mathematical model to assess the viral fitness of genetically similar viruses and the risk they represent for two important poultry species. This approach offers a rapid and scalable alternative to traditional animal models, aligning with the 3R's principle and supporting rapid assessment of the viral fitness of emerging virus variants for poultry. This approach can be easily expanded to other species, including humans, and is suitable to assess the viral fitness of all viral pathogens.
papers.abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感 病毒 (HPAIV) 在家禽中的引入、传播和后续检测受到病毒复制适应性、传播 适应性和毒力的影响。量化这些健康参数对于实施 监测 和家禽控制措施非常重要。本研究采用禽类体外模型,使用原代鸡胚成纤维细胞和鸭胚成纤维细胞来鉴定 2014 年至 2024 年间分离的 8 个主要 高致病性禽流感 分支 2.3.4.4 病毒基因型(H5N1、H5N8 和 H5N6)参考组的细胞适应性相关性。由于 HPAIV 在家禽中具有泛嗜性,因此使用原代成纤维细胞可以提供强大的适应性。评估不同家禽物种病毒适应性的系统模型。通过将纵向感染性病毒滴度和细胞致病性数据与数学模型相结合,将细胞群划分为易感区、潜伏区、感染区和死区,我们将“传统”病毒学参数(例如峰值病毒滴度和细胞死亡 50% 的时间)与机械参数(包括感染时间([公式:参见文本])、世代时间([公式:参见文本])和基本繁殖数 (R0) 分开)。我们的结果证实了 宿主 特定的健身特征与体内观察结果一致。这项研究强调了将禽类体外模型与数学模型相结合的潜力,以提供遗传相似病毒的高分辨率特征,从而实现对新型 HPAIV 的快速风险评估。重要性 家禽中的高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 暴发 在过去十年中已导致数百万只动物被扑杀。高致病性禽流感在家禽中的引入和传播是由病毒的复制、传播和引起疾病的能力驱动的,而不同的家禽种类之间的病毒复制、传播和致病的能力不同。这些病毒适应性特征可以通过 突变 或重配快速改变,从而产生具有改变的引入风险和 传播 的新变体。在这项研究中,我们整合了体外和数学模型来评估遗传相似病毒的病毒适应性及其对两种重要家禽物种的风险。这种方法为传统动物模型提供了一种快速且可扩展的替代方案,符合 3R 原则,并支持对家禽新兴病毒变种的病毒适应性进行快速评估。这种方法可以很容易地扩展到包括人类在内的其他物种,并且适合评估所有病毒病原体的病毒适应性。

papers.title: The mammalian-adaptive PB2-E627K substitution preserves viral fitness of clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 HPAIV in birds.
papers.abstract: Since emerging in 2020, clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) has disseminated globally, causing substantial infection and mortality in wild birds and poultry. Additionally, numerous spill-over events into mammals have occurred, including mass mortalities and sporadic human infections. Such events can drive the acquisition of mammalian-adaptive mutations, which further increase the risk to humans; the most well characterised mutation is the glutamate to lysine change at amino acid position 627 in the polymerase basic 2 protein (PB2-627K). Across avian influenza viruses, PB2-627K enhances polymerase activity and replication in mammalian cells, increasing zoonotic and pandemic potential. However, bioinformatic analyses indicate that PB2-627K remains rare among clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses circulating in avian populations. Here, we investigated the impact of PB2-627K on viral fitness in avian hosts to assess the potential for mammalian-adapted viruses to re-establish in birds, mimicking infection of avian species following scavenging on mammalian species where PB2-627K has already emerged. Using a representative H5N1 virus (European genotype AB), PB2-627K increased polymerase activity and replication in human cells without compromising replication in avian cells. A mammalian-derived PB2-627K H5N1 isolate from a fox exhibited comparable replication kinetics and transmission efficiency in chickens and ducks to a closely related PB2-627E virus. Notably, PB2-627K remained genetically stable at consensus level following infection and transmission in both avian hosts. These findings demonstrate that mammalian-adaptive mutations acquired during spill-over can be maintained in avian populations, potentially elevating zoonotic risk and underscoring the importance of surveillance for such mutations in birds.

papers.title_zh: 哺乳动物适应性 PB2-E627K 取代保留了鸟类中 clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 HPAIV 的病毒适应性。
papers.source_body_en: Since emerging in 2020, clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 high pathogenicity avian influenza virus (HPAIV) has disseminated globally, causing substantial infection and mortality in wild birds and poultry. Additionally, numerous spill-over events into mammals have occurred, including mass mortalities and sporadic human infections. Such events can drive the acquisition of mammalian-adaptive mutations, which further increase the risk to humans; the most well characterised mutation is the glutamate to lysine change at amino acid position 627 in the polymerase basic 2 protein (PB2-627K). Across avian influenza viruses, PB2-627K enhances polymerase activity and replication in mammalian cells, increasing zoonotic and pandemic potential. However, bioinformatic analyses indicate that PB2-627K remains rare among clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 viruses circulating in avian populations. Here, we investigated the impact of PB2-627K on viral fitness in avian hosts to assess the potential for mammalian-adapted viruses to re-establish in birds, mimicking infection of avian species following scavenging on mammalian species where PB2-627K has already emerged. Using a representative H5N1 virus (European genotype AB), PB2-627K increased polymerase activity and replication in human cells without compromising replication in avian cells. A mammalian-derived PB2-627K H5N1 isolate from a fox exhibited comparable replication kinetics and transmission efficiency in chickens and ducks to a closely related PB2-627E virus. Notably, PB2-627K remained genetically stable at consensus level following infection and transmission in both avian hosts. These findings demonstrate that mammalian-adaptive mutations acquired during spill-over can be maintained in avian populations, potentially elevating zoonotic risk and underscoring the importance of surveillance for such mutations in birds.
papers.abstract_zh: 自2020年出现以来,分支2.3.4.4b H5N1高致病性禽流感病毒(HPAIV)已在全球传播,在野生鸟类和家禽中造成大量感染和死亡率。此外,还发生了许多向哺乳动物蔓延的事件,包括大规模死亡和零星人类感染。此类事件可能会促使获得哺乳动物适应性 突变,从而进一步增加人类面临的风险;最充分表征的 突变 是聚合酶碱性 2 蛋白 (PB2-627K) 中氨基酸位置 627 处的谷氨酸到赖氨酸的变化。在 禽流感 病毒中,PB2-627K 增强哺乳动物细胞中的聚合酶活性和复制,增加人畜共患和大流行的可能性。然而,生物信息学分析表明,PB2-627K 在禽类群体中传播的分支 2.3.4.4b H5N1 病毒中仍然很少见。在这里,我们研究了 PB2-627K 对禽类 宿主 病毒适应性的影响,以评估适应哺乳动物的病毒在鸟类中重新建立的可能性,模拟鸟类在清除已经出现 PB2-627K 的哺乳动物物种后的感染。使用代表性的 H5N1 病毒(欧洲基因型 AB),PB2-627K 增加了人类细胞中的聚合酶活性和复制,而不影响禽类细胞中的复制。来自狐狸的哺乳动物来源的 PB2-627K H5N1 分离物在鸡和鸭中表现出与密切相关的 PB2-627E 病毒相当的复制动力学和 传播 效率。值得注意的是,在两种禽类 宿主 中感染 传播 后,PB2-627K 在一致水平上保持遗传稳定。这些发现表明,在溢出过程中获得的哺乳动物适应性 突变 可以在鸟类种群中维持,这可能会增加人畜共患风险,并强调 监测 对于鸟类中此类 突变 的重要性。

papers.title: Infection and transmission dynamics of bovine and human influenza A H5N1 viruses in mouse and hamster models
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Here we investigated the pathogenesis and contact transmission of bovine- and human-derived highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b genotype B3.13 viruses in mammalian models. Using reverse genetics, we rescued three naturally occurring viruses, rTX2/24 (bovine-derived), rTexas/37, and rMichigan/90 (both human-derived), and compared their infection dynamics, replication, and pathogenicity with the wild-type bovine TX2/24 strain in vitro and in vivo . All four viruses demonstrated comparable replication kinetics in four mammalian cell lines. However, the rMichigan/90 strain exhibited smaller plaques in bovine and human cells. In vivo studies showed that mice infected with any of the viruses succumbed to infection within 4–5 days; however, mice infected with the rMichigan/90 virus exhibited slightly lower viral replication and shedding compared with the other strains. The hamster model showed a milder infection phenotype than mice in which all viruses induced body weight loss and oral shedding, with robust virus replication observed in tissues, but the rMichigan/90 virus presented reduced replication and shedding. Contact transmission studies in hamsters revealed limited transmissibility for these viruses, with only one out of four animals inoculated with the rMichigan/90 virus transmitting it to a naïve contact. These findings indicate that both bovine- and human-derived H5N1 genotype B3.13 viruses present high pathogenicity in rodent models, though the overall respiratory transmissibility remains low in the hamster model. IMPORTANCE Influenza A H5N1 virus spilled over from wild birds into dairy cattle in the United States in 2024. Since then, an increased number of human infections—with at least 71 confirmed cases—have been confirmed. In the present study, we evaluated and compared the pathogenicity and transmissibility of a bovine and two human H5N1 viruses of the genotype B3.13. Our results show that while all viruses are pathogenic in mouse and hamster models, the bovine isolate TX2/24 presents a broader tissue tropism than the human-derived viruses. Contact transmission studies revealed a limited ability of these viruses to transmit in the hamster contact transmission model. These findings highlight the high pathogenicity of H5N1 viruses in mammals and demonstrate that their respiratory transmissibility potential remains low in the hamster model.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在在哺乳动物模型中研究牛源和人源 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 基因型 B3.13 病毒的 发病机制 和接触 传播。背景突出显示 H5N1 病毒 跨物种溢出 在 2024 年从 野生鸟类 进入美国奶牛,引发了对人畜共患 传播 和人类感染的担忧。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用反向遗传学拯救了三种天然存在的病毒:rTX2/24(牛源性)、rTexas/37和rMichigan/90(均源性),并在体外和体内比较了它们与野生型牛TX2/24毒株的感染动态、复制和致病性。在小鼠和仓鼠中进行体内研究,以评估病毒复制、脱落和传播性。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用反向遗传学拯救了这些病毒,并在体外和体内比较了它们的感染动态、复制和致病性。体内研究涉及用病毒感染小鼠和仓鼠,并通过接触 传播 实验监测病毒复制、脱落和传播能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有四种病毒在四种哺乳动物细胞系中都表现出类似的复制动力学。在小鼠中,与其他毒株相比,rMichigan/90 病毒的病毒复制和脱落率略低。在仓鼠中,所有病毒都会导致体重减轻和口腔脱落,并且组织复制强劲,但 rMichigan/90 病毒的复制和脱落减少。接触者 传播 研究显示,传染性有限,只有四分之一的动物接种了 rMichigan/90 病毒,将病毒传播给初次接触者。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,牛源和人源 H5N1 基因型 B3.13 病毒在啮齿动物模型中均表现出高致病性,尽管其呼吸道传播潜力在仓鼠模型中仍然较低。这些结果凸显了需要进一步研究 H5N1 病毒在不同 宿主 模型中的传播性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究深入了解了H5N1病毒在哺乳动物模型中的致病性和传播性,这对于了解人畜共患传播风险以及在动物和人类群体中制定有效的监测和禽流感控制策略至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于啮齿动物模型的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全代表人类或更广泛的动物 传播 动力学。证据是中等的,因为研究结果仅限于特定模型,并且没有考虑其他潜在的 宿主 或 传播 路线。

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于啮齿动物模型的体外和体内实验,可能无法完全代表人类或更广泛的动物 传播 动力学。证据是中等的,因为研究结果仅限于特定模型,并且没有考虑其他潜在的 宿主 或 传播 路线。

papers.title: Emerging respiratory infectious diseases: Clinical aspects for rapid identification and management.
papers.abstract: Emerging respiratory infectious diseases increasingly arise at the human-animal-environment interface and challenge clinicians with rapidly evolving diagnostic, therapeutic, and infection-control decisions. This narrative review summarizes clinically relevant viral and bacterial pathogens that may present as severe respiratory disease, but are easily mistaken for common community-acquired infections during early illness. We focus on zoonotic influenza A viruses, including contemporary H5N1, Middle East respiratory syndrome coronavirus (MERS-CoV), hantaviruses, Nipah virus, and inhalational bacterial threats such as anthrax, pneumonic plague, tularemia, and melioidosis. These infections may progress from non-specific symptoms to severe pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome, shock, neurological complications, disseminated infection, or death. Timely recognition depends on careful assessment of travel, occupational and recreational exposures, animal contact, outbreak signals, and pathogen-specific syndromic clues. Multiplex molecular diagnostics can support early triage and exclusion of common pathogens, but targeted PCR, culture, serology, sequencing, and reference laboratory confirmation remain essential. Management requires prompt supportive care, appropriate isolation, public health notification, and pathogen-directed antimicrobial, antiviral, antitoxin, or prophylactic strategies where available. By integrating clinical presentation, diagnostics, treatment, vaccines, and One Health considerations, this review aims to translate knowledge on emerging infections into practical bedside preparedness.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on avian influenza A viruses, emphasizing their role as emerging respiratory infectious diseases that challenge clinicians with rapidly evolving diagnostic and therapeutic decisions. It highlights the clinical presentation of these viruses, which can mimic common community-acquired infections, and underscores the importance of careful exposure assessment for timely recognition. The review outlines the necessity of molecular diagnostics, targeted PCR, culture, serology, and sequencing for accurate identification. It also stresses the importance of supportive care, isolation, and pathogen-directed interventions in management. While the review provides a broad overview of the clinical and diagnostic challenges, it lacks specific evidence on treatment effectiveness or long-term outcomes. The integration of clinical, diagnostic, and One Health perspectives is recommended to improve preparedness for these zoonotic threats.

papers.abstract_zh: 新兴呼吸道传染病越来越多地出现在人类与动物环境的交界处,并给临床医生快速发展的诊断、治疗和感染控制决策带来挑战。这篇叙述性综述总结了临床相关的病毒和细菌病原体,这些病原体可能表现为严重的呼吸道疾病,但在疾病早期很容易被误认为是常见的社区获得性感染。我们专注于人畜共患甲型流感病毒,包括当代 H5N1、中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒 (MERS-CoV)、汉坦病毒、尼帕病毒,以及炭疽、肺鼠疫、兔热病和类鼻疽等吸入性细菌威胁。这些感染可能从非特异性症状发展为严重肺炎、急性呼吸窘迫综合征、休克、神经系统并发症、播散性感染或死亡。及时识别取决于对旅行、职业和娱乐暴露、动物接触、暴发 信号和病原体特异性症状线索的仔细评估。多重分子诊断可以支持常见病原体的早期分类和排除,但靶向 PCR、培养、血清学、测序和参考实验室确认仍然至关重要。管理需要及时的支持护理、适当的隔离、公共卫生通知以及针对病原体的抗菌药物、抗病毒药物、抗毒素或可用的预防策略。通过整合临床表现、诊断、治疗、疫苗 和 One Health 考虑因素,本综述旨在将新发感染的知识转化为实际的床边准备。

papers.title: Mallard super-shedders of avian influenza exhibit distinct cloacal microbial abundance profiles
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In many infectious disease systems, a small fraction of hosts accounts for a disproportionate share of transmission, but the biological basis of this heterogeneity remains poorly resolved. In avian influenza, mallards show substantial variation in viral shedding, raising the possibility that only a subset of individuals contributes strongly to environmental contamination and onward spread. To examine whether host microbiome structure is associated with this variation, we experimentally infected wild, captive mallards with low-pathogenic avian influenza virus. We characterized cloacal microbiomes across control, low-shedding, and high-shedding birds using shotgun metagenomic sequencing combined with read-based taxonomic profiling and co-assembled metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) reconstruction. Although infected and uninfected birds were highly similar in species presence-absence, abundance-based analyses showed clear differences in shared taxa, particularly in high-shedding birds relative to controls. Differentially abundant taxa were dominated by taxa that belonged to groups that include host-associated opportunists, consistent with compositional imbalance rather than complete community restructuring. The phylum Pseudomonadota, especially the families Enterobacteriaceae and Moraxellaceae, is well represented. Together, these findings suggest that avian influenza infection is associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in species membership and that microbiome structure is associated with heterogeneity in shedding in a key wildlife reservoir. IMPORTANCE A small fraction of infected hosts often accounts for a disproportionate share of pathogen shedding, but the biological factors underlying this variation remain poorly understood. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多传染病系统中,宿主 的一小部分占 传播 的不成比例的份额,但这种异质性的生物学基础仍然没有得到很好的解决。在 禽流感 中,野鸭在病毒脱落方面表现出巨大差异,这增加了只有一小部分个体对环境污染和进一步传播做出重大贡献的可能性。为了检查 宿主 微生物组结构是否与这种变异相关,我们通过实验用低致病性 禽流感 病毒感染野生圈养野鸭。我们使用鸟枪法宏基因组测序结合基于读取的分类学分析和共组装宏基因组组装 基因组 (MAG) 重建,对对照、低脱落和高脱落鸟类的泄殖腔微生物组进行了表征。尽管受感染和未受感染的鸟类在物种存在与不存在方面高度相似,但基于丰度的分析显示,共享类群存在明显差异,特别是相对于对照组而言,高脱落鸟类。差异丰富的类群以属于包括 宿主 相关机会主义者在内的群体的类群为主,这与组成不平衡而不是完全的群落重组一致。假单胞菌门,特别是肠杆菌科和莫拉菌科,有很好的代表性。总之,这些发现表明,禽流感 感染与泄殖腔细菌类群丰度的变化有关,而不是物种成员的广泛变化,并且微生物组结构与关键野生动物 储存宿主 脱落的异质性有关。重要性 一小部分受感染的 宿主 通常导致病原体脱落的比例不成比例,但这种变异背后的生物学因素仍然知之甚少。在实验感染的野鸭(储存宿主 禽流感 A 病毒的一种重要野生动物)中,我们发现大量病毒脱落与泄殖腔细菌类群丰度的变化有关,而不是与微生物物种成员的广泛变化有关。这些结果表明,宿主 相关的微生物组结构可能与脱落异质性有关,并有助于解释为什么某些个体对环境污染和 传播 的影响更大。

papers.title: Advances and challenges in avian influenza vaccines: From conventional approaches to next-generation strategies
papers.abstract: Background Avian influenza viruses (AIVs), particularly highly pathogenic H5 and H7 viruses, pose major threats to poultry production, food security, international trade, and public health. Vaccination is an important component of AIV control; however, antigenic evolution, incomplete reduction of viral shedding, and challenges associated with large-scale poultry vaccination limit its effectiveness. In addition to conventional vaccines, recombinant and nucleic-acid platforms have emerged in response to rapidly evolving AIVs. Methods Relevant literature on inactivated, live attenuated, recombinant subunit, viral-vector, DNA, mRNA, and virus-like particle vaccines was evaluated. Immune responses, protection, antigenic breadth, viral shedding, delivery, manufacturing, field applicability, and regulatory considerations were analyzed. Results Inactivated vaccines are well-established, safe, scalable, and cost-effective but provide limited cellular and mucosal immunity and require antigenic matching. Live attenuated vaccines can induce broader immunity and facilitate mass vaccination but present biosafety, reassortment, and genetic-stability concerns. Next-generation platforms provide greater antigenic flexibility and opportunities for broader protection. Viral-vector vaccines can induce both humoral and cellular immunity, while recombinant subunit, DNA, mRNA, and VLP vaccines offer rapid redesign and multivalent formulations. However, challenges remain regarding delivery, stability, manufacturing, durability, and field validation. Conclusions No single platform currently meets all requirements for sustainable AIV control. Future strategies should emphasize conserved or mosaic antigens, durable and mucosal immunity, rapid vaccine updating, DIVA compatibility, and scalable delivery. Combining conventional and emerging platforms through prime-boost or multi-platform strategies may provide more flexible and effective control.

analysis.summary_en: This study reviews the current state of avian influenza vaccines, highlighting the limitations of conventional approaches and the potential of next-generation strategies. It identifies inactivated vaccines as safe and scalable but notes their limited immunity and need for antigenic matching. Live attenuated vaccines are discussed for their broader immunity and mass vaccination potential, though they raise biosafety concerns. Next-generation platforms are noted for their antigenic flexibility and opportunities for broader protection. The authors conclude that no single platform currently meets all requirements for sustainable avian influenza control and suggest future strategies should focus on conserved antigens, durable immunity, and scalable delivery. The study emphasizes the importance of combining conventional and emerging platforms through prime-boost or multi-platform strategies to enhance vaccine effectiveness. The evidence is based on a literature review, which provides moderate confidence in the findings.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 禽流感病毒(AIVs),特别是高致病性H5和H7病毒,对家禽生产、粮食安全、国际贸易和公共卫生构成重大威胁。疫苗接种是AIV控制的重要组成部分;然而,抗原性进化、病毒 shedding 减少不完全以及大规模家禽疫苗接种相关的挑战限制了其有效性。除了传统疫苗,重组和核酸平台已出现以应对快速进化的AIVs。方法 评估了有关灭活、减毒活、重组亚单位、病毒媒介、DNA、mRNA和病毒样颗粒疫苗的相关文献。分析了免疫应答、保护效果、抗原广度、病毒 shedding、递送方式、制造、现场应用和监管考虑。结果 灭活疫苗已建立、安全、可扩展且成本效益高,但其诱导的细胞和黏膜免疫有限,且需要抗原匹配。减毒活疫苗可诱导更广泛的免疫应答,并有助于大规模疫苗接种,但存在生物安全、基因重组和遗传稳定性方面的担忧。下一代平台提供了更大的抗原灵活性和更广泛的保护机会。病毒媒介 疫苗可同时诱导体液和细胞免疫,而重组亚单位、DNA、mRNA和VLP 疫苗则提供了快速重新设计和多价制剂的可能性。然而,关于递送、稳定性、制造、持续性和现场验证仍存在挑战。结论 目前没有一种平台能够满足可持续AIV控制的所有要求。未来策略应强调保守或拼接抗原、持久且黏膜免疫、快速疫苗更新、DIVA兼容性以及可扩展的递送方式。通过加强接种或多种平台策略结合传统和新兴平台,可能提供更灵活和有效的控制手段。

papers.title: A modelling challenge to improve preparedness for highly pathogenic avian influenza epidemics: objectives, design and synthetic data generation
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is among the most significant disease threats to poultry worldwide. Modelling challenges, where independent teams address a common epidemiological scenario, can support the development of response capabilities and strengthen communication between modellers and risk managers. Despite the established benefits of these exercises, they remain uncommon in animal health, and none have previously addressed avian influenza. Here Jolly Island, an artificial landscape of 9160 poultry farms with five production types, was developed and seeded with stochastic HPAI epidemics that ran their course over a three-to-four month period. From January through April 2026, 45 registered teams across five continents investigated a selected synthetic epidemic, producing probabilistic forecasts, inferring transmission drivers, and evaluating counterfactual control policies. Here the objectives, design choices, and data generation of the HPAI Modelling Challenge are described in full, covering transmission processes, surveillance system operations, and control strategy implementation, along with the selected epidemic trajectory, the narrative situation reports supplied to the teams at each phase, and the complete phase-specific datasets released to them. As the opening paper of this special issue, here is provided the foundation upon which all subsequent contributions, where teams document their approaches and analyses, are built.

The challenge was based on an artificial landscape of 9160 poultry farms with five production types.
analysis.methods: The challenge involved developing a synthetic epidemic of HPAI, seeding it with stochastic outbreaks, and providing narrative situation reports to the teams at each phase. Phase-specific datasets were released to the teams for analysis.
analysis.main_results: The study described the design, transmission processes, surveillance system operations, and control strategy implementation of the HPAI Modelling Challenge. It also outlined the selected epidemic trajectory and the datasets provided to the teams.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the challenge as a foundation for subsequent contributions where teams document their approaches and analyses. The novelty lies in the comprehensive description of the HPAI Modelling Challenge.

papers.title_zh: 改善 高致病性禽流感 流行病准备情况的建模挑战:目标、设计和合成数据生成
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is among the most significant disease threats to poultry worldwide. Modelling challenges, where independent teams address a common epidemiological scenario, can support the development of response capabilities and strengthen communication between modellers and risk managers. Despite the established benefits of these exercises, they remain uncommon in animal health, and none have previously addressed avian influenza. Here Jolly Island, an artificial landscape of 9160 poultry farms with five production types, was developed and seeded with stochastic HPAI epidemics that ran their course over a three-to-four month period. From January through April 2026, 45 registered teams across five continents investigated a selected synthetic epidemic, producing probabilistic forecasts, inferring transmission drivers, and evaluating counterfactual control policies. Here the objectives, design choices, and data generation of the HPAI Modelling Challenge are described in full, covering transmission processes, surveillance system operations, and control strategy implementation, along with the selected epidemic trajectory, the narrative situation reports supplied to the teams at each phase, and the complete phase-specific datasets released to them. As the opening paper of this special issue, here is provided the foundation upon which all subsequent contributions, where teams document their approaches and analyses, are built.
papers.abstract_zh: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 是全球家禽面临的最严重的疾病威胁之一。独立团队应对常见流行病学场景的建模挑战可以支持响应能力的发展并加强建模者和风险管理者之间的沟通。尽管这些练习具有既定的好处,但它们在动物健康方面仍然不常见,并且以前没有一个解决过 禽流感 问题。这里的欢乐岛是一个由 9160 个家禽养殖场组成的人工景观,具有五种生产类型,是在三到四个月的时间内发展和传播随机 HPAI 流行病的。从 2026 年 1 月到 2026 年 4 月,五大洲的 45 个注册团队调查了选定的综合流行病,进行概率预测,推断 传播 驱动因素,并评估反事实控制政策。这里详细描述了 HPAI 建模挑战赛的目标、设计选择和数据生成,涵盖 传播 流程、监测 系统操作和控制策略实施,以及选定的流行轨迹、每个阶段向团队提供的叙述情况报告以及向他们发布的完整阶段特定数据集。作为本期特刊的开篇论文,这里提供了所有后续贡献(团队记录其方法和分析)的基础。

papers.title: Administration of the mRNA-H5 vaccine to ferrets via jet injection provides protective immunity against the H5N1 influenza virus
papers.abstract: The highly pathogenic avian influenza virus subtype H5Nx is rapidly evolving and infecting various species of wild and domestic mammals, including cattle, highlighting its pandemic potential for humans. To combat the pandemic threat, it is essential to develop suitable vaccine platforms, including mRNA vaccines, the efficacy of which largely depends on the delivery system. This study evaluates the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of the mRNA-H5 vaccine, delivered via lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and jet injection (JI). The aim of the study was to evaluate the immunogenic and protective properties of the experimental mRNA-H5 vaccine in a ferret model. MATERIALS AND METHODS. Ferrets were immunized twice with the mRNA-H5 vaccine at a dose of 30 μg formulated with LNPs and at a dose of 100 μg administered by JI. Sera from immunized ferrets were analyzed using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) against the recombinant HA/H5 protein, an enzyme-linked immunospot (ELISpot) assay using a pool of specific peptides, and a virus neutralization assay in MDCK-SIAT1 cell culture using the influenza virus strain A/turkey/Stavropol/320-01/2020 (H5N8). Immunized ferrets were intranasally challenged with 5 LD 50 of the influenza virus strain A/dalmatian pelican/Kalmykia/ 330-10V/2023 (H5N1), and their status was recorded for 14 days after challenge. Using ELISA, it was established that specific antibody titers were determined in groups of animals immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs; the average titers in the groups were 1:180,000 and 1:4,000,000, respectively. Using the virus neutralization assay, sera from animals immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs had virus-neutralizing activity; the average 50% neutralizing titers were 1:250 and 1:1500, respectively. The ELISpot assay showed that in groups of ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine, specific cellular immunity was induced. Immunization with the mRNA-H5 vaccine provided 100% protection against mortality in ferrets challenged with 5 LD 50 of the influenza virus strain A/dalmatian pelican/Kalmykia/330-10V/2023 (H5N1). This study demonstrated the effective induction of virus-specific humoral and cellular immune responses in ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs.

This study evaluates the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of the mRNA-H5 vaccine, delivered via lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and jet injection (JI). The aim of the study was to evaluate the immunogenic and protective properties of the experimental mRNA-H5 vaccine in a ferret model. MATERIALS AND METHODS. Ferrets were immunized twice with the mRNA-H5 vaccine at a dose of 30 μg formulated with LNPs and at a dose of 100 μg administered by JI. Sera from immunized ferrets were analyzed using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) against the recombinant HA/H5 protein, an enzyme-linked immunospot (ELISpot) assay using a pool of specific peptides, and a virus neutralization assay in MDCK-SIAT1 cell culture using the influenza virus strain A/turkey/Stavropol/320-01/2020 (H5N8). Immunized ferrets were intranasally challenged with 5 LD 50 of the influenza virus strain A/dalmatian pelican/Kalmykia/ 330-10V/2023 (H5N1), and their status was recorded for 14 days after challenge. Using ELISA, it was established that specific antibody titers were determined in groups of animals immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs; the average titers in the groups were 1:180,000 and 1:4,000,000, respectively. Using the virus neutralization assay, sera from animals immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs had virus-neutralizing activity; the average 50% neutralizing titers were 1:250 and 1:1500, respectively. The ELISpot assay showed that in groups of ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine, specific cellular immunity was induced. Immunization with the mRNA-H5 vaccine provided 100% protection against mortality in ferrets challenged with 5 LD 50 of the influenza virus strain A/dalmatian pelican/Kalmykia/330-10V/2023 (H5N1). This study demonstrated the effective induction of virus-specific humoral and cellular immune responses in ferrets immunized with the mRNA-H5 vaccine administered by JI or formulated with LNPs.

papers.title_original: Administration of the mRNA-H5 vaccine to ferrets via jet injection provides protective immunity against the H5N1 influenza virus

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed due to the rapid evolution of H5Nx avian influenza viruses and their ability to infect various mammals, including cattle, which highlights the pandemic potential for humans. The research aimed to address the need for effective vaccine platforms, particularly mRNA vaccines, whose efficacy depends on the delivery system.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a ferret model to evaluate the immunogenic and protective properties of the experimental mRNA-H5 vaccine. Ferrets were immunized twice with the vaccine at different doses and delivery methods, and their immune responses were assessed following viral challenge.
analysis.methods: The study used enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), enzyme-linked immunospot (ELISpot) assay, and virus neutralization assay in MDCK-SIAT1 cell culture to analyze immune responses. Ferrets were challenged with a specific H5N1 strain, and their status was monitored for 14 days post-challenge.
analysis.main_results: Immunized ferrets showed high specific antibody titers, with average titers of 1:180,000 and 1:4,000,000 in the JI and LNP groups, respectively. The virus neutralization assay revealed average 50% neutralizing titers of 1:250 and 1:1500. The ELISpot assay confirmed the induction of specific cellular immunity in vaccinated ferrets.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the mRNA-H5 vaccine effectively induces both humoral and cellular immune responses in ferrets, which is a novel result in the context of evaluating vaccine delivery methods for H5N1 influenza.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide important insights into the potential of mRNA vaccines for protecting against H5N1 influenza, which could inform future vaccine development and public health strategies for avian-origin zoonotic infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a ferret model, which may not fully represent human immune responses. However, the evidence is strong as it directly reports on the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of the vaccine in a relevant animal model.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of an mRNA-H5 vaccine against H5N1 influenza in a ferret model. The research is motivated by the pandemic potential of H5Nx avian influenza viruses, which can infect various mammals. The vaccine was administered via lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) and jet injection (JI), and immune responses were assessed using ELISA, ELISpot, and virus neutralization assays. The results showed that both delivery methods induced high antibody titers and neutralizing activity, with the JI group demonstrating 100% protection against mortality following viral challenge. The findings suggest that the mRNA-H5 vaccine is effective in generating immune responses against H5N1 influenza, which has implications for vaccine development. However, the study is limited to a ferret model, and the evidence is strong due to the direct evaluation of vaccine efficacy in this context.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于 H5Nx 进化 病毒的快速 进化 及其感染包括牛在内的各种哺乳动物的能力,因此需要进行这项研究,这凸显了人类大流行的可能性。该研究旨在满足对有效 疫苗 平台的需求,特别是 mRNA 疫苗,其功效取决于递送系统。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在雪貂模型中进行,旨在评估实验 mRNA-H5 疫苗 的免疫原性和保护特性。使用 疫苗 以不同剂量和递送方法对雪貂进行两次免疫,并在病毒攻击后评估其 免疫应答。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究在MDCK-SIAT1细胞培养物中使用酶联免疫吸附测定(ELISA)、酶联免疫斑点(ELISpot)测定和病毒中和测定来分析免疫应答。雪貂接受了特定 H5N1 毒株的攻击,并在攻击后 14 天监测其状态。
elements_zh.main_results: 免疫后的雪貂表现出较高的特异性抗体滴度,JI组和LNP组的平均滴度分别为1:180,000和1:4,000,000。病毒中和测定显示平均 50% 中和滴度为 1:250 和 1:1500。ELISpot 测定证实了接种疫苗的雪貂中诱导了特异性细胞免疫。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,mRNA-H5 疫苗 在雪貂中有效诱导体液和细胞 免疫应答,这是评估 H5N1 流感 疫苗 递送方法的新结果。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为了解 mRNA 疫苗 预防 H5N1 流感的潜力提供了重要见解,这可以为未来 疫苗 的开发和针对禽源人畜共患感染的公共卫生策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于雪貂模型,可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它直接报告了 疫苗 在相关动物模型中的免疫原性和保护功效。

analysis_zh.main_results: 免疫后的雪貂表现出较高的特异性抗体滴度,JI组和LNP组的平均滴度分别为1:180,000和1:4,000,000。病毒中和测定显示平均 50% 中和滴度为 1:250 和 1:1500。ELISpot 测定证实了接种疫苗的雪貂中诱导了特异性细胞免疫。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,mRNA-H5 疫苗 在雪貂中有效诱导体液和细胞 免疫应答,这是评估 H5N1 流感 疫苗 递送方法的新结果。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为了解 mRNA 疫苗 预防 H5N1 流感的潜力提供了重要见解,这可以为未来 疫苗 的开发和针对禽源人畜共患感染的公共卫生策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于雪貂模型,可能无法完全代表人类 免疫应答。然而,证据是强有力的,因为它直接报告了 疫苗 在相关动物模型中的免疫原性和保护功效。

papers.title: An adenovirus-based mucosal vaccine induces cross-neutralizing antibodies and protects against lethal H5N1 infection in ferrets
papers.abstract: Background H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) has been detected in multiple animal species, including humans, posing a significant threat to public health. Vaccines capable of eliciting robust mucosal and systemic immunity are needed to protect against HPAI infection. Methods First- and second-generation non-replicating adenovirus type-5 vectored vaccines expressing hemagglutinin (HA) from clade 2.1.3.2 (ND1.1) and clade 2.3.4.4b (VXA-H5-02), were administered via peroral route to ferrets. Mucosal and systemic immunogenicity were evaluated. Protective efficacy, viral burden, and shedding was assessed against clade 2.3.4.4b challenge, for clade-matched VXA-H5–02 and clade-mismatched ND1.1 vaccines. Results Immunization elicited mucosal immunity and serum neutralizing activity in ferrets against homologous and heterologous clades. All control animals rapidly succumbed to the lethal 2.3.4.4b clade challenge, compared with survival rates of 38% and 100% in the ND1.1 and VXA-H5–02 vaccine groups, respectively. VXA-H5–02 immunization significantly reduced illness, viral burden, and shedding. Conclusion Second-generation VXA-H5–02 is a promising vaccine candidate capable of inducing systemic and mucosal immunity, offering broad protection against HPAI.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the efficacy of an adenovirus-based mucosal vaccine against H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). The research is motivated by the public health threat posed by HPAI, which has been detected in multiple species, including humans. The study design involves administering first- and second-generation non-replicating adenovirus type-5 vaccines expressing hemagglutinin from clade 2.1.3.2 (ND1.1) and clade 2.3.4.4b (VXA-H5-02) via the peroral route to ferrets. Protective efficacy, viral burden, and shedding were assessed against clade 2.3.4.4b challenge. Results showed that immunization elicited mucosal immunity and serum neutralizing activity against homologous and heterologous clades. All control animals succumbed to the challenge, while survival rates were 38% and 100% in the ND1.1 and VXA-H5–02 vaccine groups, respectively. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that VXA-H5–02 is a promising vaccine candidate capable of inducing broad protection against HPAI. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform vaccine development for avian influenza in humans and other species. However, the study is limited to ferrets and does not report human trials, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is strong based on direct observations of survival and viral burden reduction.

papers.title: Highly pathogenic avian influenza as a systemic risk - implications for control and preparedness
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) has evolved from episodic outbreaks into a globally entrenched, multi-host panzootic, with recurrent spillover into mammals. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 已从偶发性 暴发 演变成全球范围内根深蒂固的多 宿主 泛动物疫情,并在哺乳动物中反复出现 跨物种溢出。宿主范围的扩大和野生动物与牲畜接触的增加对传统的控制策略提出了挑战,增加了病毒适应的机会,从而提高了人畜共患病的风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对高致病性禽流感作为一种系统性风险进行了概念分析,重点关注其全球传播及其对控制和准备的影响。它研究了高致病性禽流感的演变性质及其对多个 宿主 物种和生态系统的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及对现有文献的回顾以及对 HPAI 的生态和流行病学特征的分析,包括其 宿主 范围和 传播 动态。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,HPAI 已从偶发性 暴发 转变为持续性、多 宿主 的大流行,在哺乳动物中反复出现 跨物种溢出 事件。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为强调需要将高致病性禽流感重新定义为一种长期系统性风险,需要基于复原力的治理和增强的“同一个健康”方法来进行控制和准备。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为制定更强大的 HPAI 监测、控制和准备策略提供了信息,强调了“One Health”方法对于减轻人畜共患病风险的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于仅摘要的综述,这可能会限制分析的深度。然而,证据是基于所报道的高致病性禽流感的特征及其对公共卫生的影响。

papers.title: In- Silico Evaluation of Matrix Gene RT-PCR Primer and Probe Binding Site Stability in Influenza A H5N1 and Implications for Diagnostic Assay Performance
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Real-time RT-PCR assays targeting the influenza A matrix (M) gene are widely used in clinical laboratories for routine detection of H5N1 infections. Viral genetic drift may compromise primer and probe binding efficiency, potentially affecting assay sensitivity. Continuous evaluation of binding site stability is therefore essential for diagnostic reliability. Methods: Forty-nine full-length matrix gene sequences of influenza A (H5N1) collected between 1996–2025 and included isolates from: Homo sapiens, Avian species, other mammalian hosts (accession numbers provided on the tables). Only sequences covering nucleotide positions 79–175 were included. Gene sequences were retrieved from the NCBI GenBank database. Multiple sequence alignment was performed using (MUSCLE in MEGA software). Primer and probe binding regions corresponding to coordinates 79–97 (forward primer), 120–138 (probe), and 154–175 (reverse primer) were evaluated for nucleotide mismatches. Frequencies of substitutions were calculated and stratified by host and temporal distribution. Results: All sequences fully covered the evaluated binding regions. The majority of isolates demonstrated complete conservation within primer and probe sites. Observed substitutions were infrequent and primarily single nucleotide mismatches. No extensive multi-site disruptions were identified within any binding region. Substitution patterns showed temporal clustering but did not suggest widespread destabilization of assay target regions. Conclusion: The results indicate that the evaluated matrix gene RT-qPCR assay demonstrates substantial tolerance to isolated nucleotide substitutions, with most circulating strains remaining within predicted tolerance limits. Observed limited mismatches are unlikely to significantly compromise diagnostic assay performance. Continued molecular surveillance of primer and probe binding sites is recommended to maintain analytical sensitivity in clinical laboratories.

papers.title_zh: 甲型 H5N1 流感中基质基因 RT-PCR 引物和探针结合位点稳定性的计算机评估及其对诊断分析性能的影响
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: Real-time RT-PCR assays targeting the influenza A matrix (M) gene are widely used in clinical laboratories for routine detection of H5N1 infections. Viral genetic drift may compromise primer and probe binding efficiency, potentially affecting assay sensitivity. Continuous evaluation of binding site stability is therefore essential for diagnostic reliability. Methods: Forty-nine full-length matrix gene sequences of influenza A (H5N1) collected between 1996–2025 and included isolates from: Homo sapiens, Avian species, other mammalian hosts (accession numbers provided on the tables). Only sequences covering nucleotide positions 79–175 were included. Gene sequences were retrieved from the NCBI GenBank database. Multiple sequence alignment was performed using (MUSCLE in MEGA software). Primer and probe binding regions corresponding to coordinates 79–97 (forward primer), 120–138 (probe), and 154–175 (reverse primer) were evaluated for nucleotide mismatches. Frequencies of substitutions were calculated and stratified by host and temporal distribution. Results: All sequences fully covered the evaluated binding regions. The majority of isolates demonstrated complete conservation within primer and probe sites. Observed substitutions were infrequent and primarily single nucleotide mismatches. No extensive multi-site disruptions were identified within any binding region. Substitution patterns showed temporal clustering but did not suggest widespread destabilization of assay target regions. Conclusion: The results indicate that the evaluated matrix gene RT-qPCR assay demonstrates substantial tolerance to isolated nucleotide substitutions, with most circulating strains remaining within predicted tolerance limits. Observed limited mismatches are unlikely to significantly compromise diagnostic assay performance. Continued molecular surveillance of primer and probe binding sites is recommended to maintain analytical sensitivity in clinical laboratories.

papers.title: H5 influenza virus mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (LNP) vaccination elicits adaptive immune responses in Holstein calves.
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 circulated widely in lactating dairy cows in the United States following the initial detection in 2024. Due to the critical need for intervention strategies for this outbreak, we evaluated antibody and cellular immune responses of a clade 2.3.4.4b H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine in calves. We found that the H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine induced a robust antibody and CD8+ T cell-mediated immune response and conferred protection against clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection.IMPORTANCEIt is important to develop vaccines that limit clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection in cattle. In this study, we found that a new H5 mRNA-lipid nanoparticle vaccine is immunogenic when delivered intramuscularly to male Holstein calves.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 circulated widely in lactating dairy cows in the United States following the initial detection in 2024. Due to the critical need for intervention strategies for this outbreak, we evaluated antibody and cellular immune responses of a clade 2.3.4.4b H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine in calves.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: We evaluated antibody and cellular immune responses of a clade 2.3.4.4b H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine in male Holstein calves.
analysis_en.methods: We induced a robust antibody and CD8+ T cell-mediated immune response and conferred protection against clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection using a new H5 mRNA-lipid nanoparticle vaccine delivered intramuscularly.
analysis_en.main_results: We found that the H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine induced a robust antibody and CD8+ T cell-mediated immune response and conferred protection against clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that the H5 mRNA-LNP vaccine is immunogenic when delivered intramuscularly to male Holstein calves, which is a novel approach for combating clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection in cattle.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide important insights into the development of vaccines that can limit clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 infection in cattle, which has significant implications for controlling avian-origin zoonotic infections.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to male Holstein calves and does not report on the generalisability of the findings to other cattle populations or species. The evidence is based on a single study with a limited sample size, which suggests a moderate confidence level.

papers.title: Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha inhibition mitigates inflammatory responses induced by H9N2 avian influenza virus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses significant threats to poultry and public health, with the potential to contribute to the emergence of more virulent influenza strains. Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1α) plays a crucial role in viral pathogenesis, immune regulation, and inflammation, making it a promising target for therapeutic intervention. Here, we explored the involvement of HIF-1α in H9N2 AIV pathogenesis and associated inflammatory responses. Our data revealed that HIF-1α exacerbates inflammation induced by H9N2 AIV infection through its regulation of mitochondrial fitness. Additionally, we investigated Sotetsuflavone (Seo), a naturally derived flavonoid, for its potential to modulate inflammatory responses following H9N2 infection. Molecular docking coupled with surface plasmon resonance assays indicated that Seo exhibits robust binding affinity to HIF-1α, implying a direct inhibitory mechanism. Subsequent in vitro studies demonstrated that Seo greatly reduced the production of inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α, through suppressing the HIF-1α signaling pathway in HD11 cells infected with H9N2 AIV. Correspondingly, in vivo experiments established that Seo administration significantly ameliorated pulmonary inflammation in H9N2-infected mice, while also enhancing alveolar epithelial repair, as evidenced by increased expression of type II alveolar epithelial cell markers Abca3 and Sftpb. Collectively, these findings identify Seo as a potent inhibitor of HIF-1α, highlighting its therapeutic potential in mitigating inflammation and lung damage associated with influenza virus infection. IMPORTANCE H9N2 avian influenza virus triggers inflammatory lung injury via hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1α)-mediated dysregulation of mitochondrial function. The natural flavonoid Sotetsuflavone (Seo) directly binds and inhibits HIF-1α, as confirmed by molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance assays. In H9N2-infected HD11 cells, Seo suppresses HIF-1α signaling, reducing IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α production. In vivo , Seo treatment attenuates pulmonary inflammation and enhances alveolar epithelial repair in mice, upregulating type II pneumocyte markers (Abca3 and Sftpb). These findings identify Seo as a promising HIF-1α-targeted therapeutic for influenza-associated immunopathology.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of HIF-1α in H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) pathogenesis and to explore the potential of Sotetsuflavone (Seo) as a therapeutic agent. H9N2 AIV poses significant threats to poultry and public health, with the potential to contribute to the emergence of more virulent influenza strains.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study explored the involvement of HIF-1α in H9N2 AIV pathogenesis and associated inflammatory responses in vitro and in vivo. The research was conducted using HD11 cells and H9N2-infected mice.
elements_en.methods: Molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance assays were used to confirm the binding affinity of Seo to HIF-1α. In vitro studies were conducted using HD11 cells infected with H9N2 AIV, and in vivo experiments were performed in H9N2-infected mice.
elements_en.main_results: Seo was found to reduce the production of inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α, through suppressing the HIF-1α signaling pathway in HD11 cells infected with H9N2 AIV. In vivo, Seo treatment significantly ameliorated pulmonary inflammation and enhanced alveolar epithelial repair in H9N2-infected mice.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings identify Seo as a potent inhibitor of HIF-1α, highlighting its therapeutic potential in mitigating inflammation and lung damage associated with influenza virus infection.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Seo could be a promising HIF-1α-targeted therapeutic for influenza-associated immunopathology, potentially reducing the severity of lung damage and enhancing alveolar epithelial repair.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by the use of a single flavonoid and a single avian influenza virus subtype, which may not generalize to other subtypes or species. The evidence strength is moderate due to the in vitro and in vivo experimental nature of the study.

papers.title_zh: 缺氧诱导因子 1-α 抑制可减轻 H9N2 禽流感 病毒诱导的炎症反应
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT H9N2 avian influenza virus (AIV) poses significant threats to poultry and public health, with the potential to contribute to the emergence of more virulent influenza strains. Hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1α) plays a crucial role in viral pathogenesis, immune regulation, and inflammation, making it a promising target for therapeutic intervention. Here, we explored the involvement of HIF-1α in H9N2 AIV pathogenesis and associated inflammatory responses. Our data revealed that HIF-1α exacerbates inflammation induced by H9N2 AIV infection through its regulation of mitochondrial fitness. Additionally, we investigated Sotetsuflavone (Seo), a naturally derived flavonoid, for its potential to modulate inflammatory responses following H9N2 infection. Molecular docking coupled with surface plasmon resonance assays indicated that Seo exhibits robust binding affinity to HIF-1α, implying a direct inhibitory mechanism. Subsequent in vitro studies demonstrated that Seo greatly reduced the production of inflammatory cytokines, including IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α, through suppressing the HIF-1α signaling pathway in HD11 cells infected with H9N2 AIV. Correspondingly, in vivo experiments established that Seo administration significantly ameliorated pulmonary inflammation in H9N2-infected mice, while also enhancing alveolar epithelial repair, as evidenced by increased expression of type II alveolar epithelial cell markers Abca3 and Sftpb. Collectively, these findings identify Seo as a potent inhibitor of HIF-1α, highlighting its therapeutic potential in mitigating inflammation and lung damage associated with influenza virus infection. IMPORTANCE H9N2 avian influenza virus triggers inflammatory lung injury via hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1α)-mediated dysregulation of mitochondrial function. The natural flavonoid Sotetsuflavone (Seo) directly binds and inhibits HIF-1α, as confirmed by molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance assays. In H9N2-infected HD11 cells, Seo suppresses HIF-1α signaling, reducing IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α production. In vivo , Seo treatment attenuates pulmonary inflammation and enhances alveolar epithelial repair in mice, upregulating type II pneumocyte markers (Abca3 and Sftpb). These findings identify Seo as a promising HIF-1α-targeted therapeutic for influenza-associated immunopathology.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 H9N2 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) 对家禽和公共卫生构成重大威胁,并有可能导致毒性更强的流感病毒株的出现。缺氧诱导因子 1-α (HIF-1α) 在病毒 发病机制、免疫调节和炎症中发挥着至关重要的作用,使其成为治疗干预的有希望的靶点。在这里,我们探讨了 HIF-1α 在 H9N2 AIV 发病机制 中的参与以及相关的炎症反应。我们的数据显示,HIF-1α 通过调节线粒体健康度,加剧了 H9N2 AIV 感染引起的炎症。此外,我们还研究了 Sotetsuflavone (Seo)(一种天然衍生的黄酮类化合物),了解其调节 H9N2 感染后炎症反应的潜力。分子对接结合表面等离子共振测定表明 Seo 对 HIF-1α 表现出强大的结合亲和力,这意味着直接抑制机制。随后的体外研究表明,Seo 通过抑制感染 H9N2 AIV 的 HD11 细胞中的 HIF-1α 信号通路,大大减少了炎症细胞因子的产生,包括 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α。相应地,体内实验证实,Seo 给药显着改善 H9N2 感染小鼠的肺部炎症,同时还增强肺泡上皮修复,II 型肺泡上皮细胞标记物 Abca3 和 Sftpb 表达增加证明了这一点。总的来说,这些发现将 Seo 确定为 HIF-1α 的有效抑制剂,突显了其在减轻与流感病毒感染相关的炎症和肺损伤方面的治疗潜力。重要性 H9N2 禽流感 病毒通过缺氧诱导因子 1 α (HIF-1α) 介导的线粒体功能失调引发炎症性肺损伤。分子对接和表面等离子共振测定证实,天然类黄酮 Sotetsuflavone (Seo) 直接结合并抑制 HIF-1α。在 H9N2 感染的 HD11 细胞中,Seo 抑制 HIF-1α 信号传导,减少 IL-1β、IL-6 和 TNF-α 的产生。在体内,Seo 治疗 可减轻小鼠肺部炎症并增强肺泡上皮修复,上调 II 型肺细胞标记物(Abca3 和 Sftpb)。这些发现表明 Seo 是一种有前途的 HIF-1α 靶向疗法,用于治疗流感相关的免疫病理学。
